fact: UGPE reports an upgrade of SYDONIA World at Cape Verde's customs offices, including migration to version 4.4.0 and new customs modules, in a project running November 2023 to July 2026.

ASYCUDA reports that Cabo Verde launched the ASYVAL valuation control module in ASYCUDAWorld in March 2025, which flags deviating import declarations automatically and raised customs revenue by 2.49% on average across 12 product categories.
Cabo Verde hosted an ECOWAS mission on 18-21 November 2024 to implement the SIGMAT transit system, and customs chose the SIGMAT mobile version for inter-island transit.
